subject: pharmacy
intro: Pharmacy leads to the medication experts — pharmacists who counsel and verify, technicians who prepare doses, and the scientists who design and study the molecules themselves.

roles.title: Pharmacists
roles.what: Dispense drugs prescribed by physicians and other health practitioners, provide patients with information about their medications, and advise prescribers on selection, dosage, interactions and side effects.
roles.where: Pharmacotherapy for chronic disease and for infection and oncology, interaction science with pharmacogenomics, and patient care and counselling are the NAPLEX competencies this role exercises at the bench daily.

roles.title: Pharmacy Technicians
roles.what: Prepare medications under the direction of a pharmacist — measuring, mixing, counting out, labelling and recording amounts and dosages according to prescription orders.
roles.where: Dosage forms and compounding — sterile and non-sterile work, bioavailability and excipients — and the medication-safety unit on high-alert and look-alike/sound-alike drugs are the daily craft of this role.

roles.title: Medical Scientists, Except Epidemiologists
roles.what: Conduct research dealing with the understanding of human diseases and the improvement of human health — clinical investigation and research and development that test how new therapies perform before and after approval.
roles.where: Pharmaceutical sciences foundations — medicinal chemistry and SAR, pharmacokinetics ADME, pharmacodynamics — plus chemotherapy principles give you the research vocabulary that drug trials are built on.

roles.title: Chemists
roles.what: Analyse substances and study their structure and reactions — in pharma, synthesising and characterising candidate molecules and assaying the purity and stability of what gets bottled.
roles.where: Medicinal chemistry and SAR from the pharmaceutical sciences unit, plus formulation science and the excipients work in dosage forms, are applied directly in the synthetic and analytical lab work of drug chemistry.
